# Savings Projector Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when projecting savings over time, calculating NPV, IRR, payback period, modeling financial scenarios, or performing sensitivity analysis.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [savings-projector-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
savings-projector-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@savings-projector` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze business processes and identify improvement opportunities
- Apply domain best practices and industry-standard frameworks
- Assess current state against maturity models and benchmarks
- Generate findings with severity classification and remediation guidance

## Industry Standards Applied

- **FinOps Framework**: Cloud financial management: inform, optimize, operate
- **Well-Architected (Cost)**: Cost optimization pillar: right-sizing, reserved capacity, waste elimination
